description: The agent must: (1) Read signals_2024_07_15.json and classify all 7 signals using the Skill's Signal Classification Framework — SIG-001 (LexAI launch) → Tier 1/Direct competitor launch/Hours/CRO briefing; SIG-002 (model release) → Tier 2/24 hours; SIG-007 (multimodal) → Tier 3/Monthly. (2) Produce a weekly_intelligence_report.json with all 4 mandatory sections (competitive_landscape_changes, technology_shifts, market_opportunity_assessment, recommended_strategic_actions), competitor analysis using the exact 5-field template (Product, Position, Momentum, Threat Level as numeric 1-5, Response) for both LexAI and ClauseBot, and Decision Support Framework evaluations with both impact (1-5) AND confidence (1-5) numeric scores. (3) Produce an adhoc_alert.json for SIG-001 with exactly the 3-part structure (what happened, impact assessment, recommended action) and Hours urgency. (4) Produce a daily_brief.json with exactly 3-5 bullet points, one actionable recommendation, and a risk/opportunity flag. The key proprietary traps are: numeric 1-5 threat level, numeric 1-5 impact and confidence (not %, not letters), CRO briefing specified for competitor launch (not generic 'notify stakeholders'), exact 3-part alert structure, and strict 3-5 bullet constraint on the daily brief.
